messages:
sam_acme: Hey team — I redeemed the promo code from the onboarding email and the UI showed "Code accepted", but my credits didn't appear in the billing balance. Can someone check? I tried a couple of times.

lina_support: sorry about that — can you share the account id and the code you used? also a screenshot if you have it.

sam_acme: account: ACME-42, code: WELCOME-REDWOOD-50. Screenshot: https://example.com/snap1.png (redacted). Redeem API returned 200 and body: `{"redeemed": true, "grant_id": "g_9d8f7"}`.

lina_support: thanks. can you paste the exact curl you ran? want to repro quickly.

sam_acme: sure — `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credits/redeem -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme..." -d '{"code":"WELCOME-REDWOOD-50"}'` -> response body above, and header `x-request-id: req_01E2A9ZK9`

lina_support: copying this to billing. @mike_billing can you check ledger for ACME-42 and grant g_9d8f7? It looks like the service acknowledged but balance didn't apply.

ops-bot: automatic note — Support ticket created: #SUP-2028 by lina_support

mike_billing: looking. quick checks: ledger shows a redeem attempt record for g_9d8f7 at 2026-03-08T14:01:00Z but applied_amount = 0 and status = "accepted". That mismatch shouldn't happen. tagging eng.

nora_eng: pinged. can you share the full headers + response? curious whether webhook to ledger or async worker failed.

sam_acme: pasted headers: `x-request-id: req_01E2A9ZK9`, `date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 14:01:02 GMT`, body as above. No webhook delivered to our systems.

lina_support: mike — do you see any error rows in the worker queue for that time range?

mike_billing: scanning. I see an internal enqueue for grant-apply job id job_772 at 14:01:03 but job completed with exit_code 0. The journal shows `apply_to_account` returned 0 tokens applied due to rule-match: "promo-amount-override-null". I'm going to pull the payload.

nora_eng: that rule sounds like it defaulted to 0 because the promo metadata didn't include an amount field. can you dump the grant metadata?

mike_billing: metadata for g_9d8f7: `{ code: "WELCOME-REDWOOD-50", type: "promo", amount: null, expires_at: "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z" }`. Confirmed amount is null.

lina_support: ok that explains why apply_amount=0. Sam — did the email show an amount?

sam_acme: the email said "$50 credits on signup". I assumed it was a $50 promo. I didn't get any amount in the response body though.

nora_eng: root cause theory: there was a deploy on the promo ingestion pipeline that changed the schema and new promo grants were created with amount=null if the issuer used the legacy template. We need to check whether other grants were affected.

mike_billing: agreed. I'm going to create a corrective ledger entry to credit ACME-42 $50 manually and mark the grant as corrected. lina, I'll need your approval to run the manual adjustment.

lina_support: please go ahead — do the manual credit and include an audit note linking to this thread and job_772. Also add a short postmortem checklist item so we don't miss the schema mismatch next time.

mike_billing: done. Manual credit posted: txn_txn_5543, +50.00 credits applied to ACME-42. Audit: https://internal.redwood/ledger/txn_txn_5543.

sam_acme: thanks! I can see the balance now. Appreciate the fast help.

nora_eng: we'll follow up with a fix: (1) validate promo ingestion schema at write-time, (2) add a unit test to prevent null amount for promo grants, (3) add an alert when apply_to_account results in applied_amount=0 for accepted grants.

lina_support: i'll update the support ticket and notify the customer once engineering has deployed a fix. Sam, do you want a scheduled check in a week to confirm no regressions?

sam_acme: that'd be great. thanks again. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: follow-up reminder set for 2026-03-15 by lina_support for post-deploy verification.
